mapper.sql: id, sender_id, receiver_id, content, status, read_status, read_at, recalled_at, deleted, version, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_message WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT FROM user_message WHERE deleted = 0 AND status != 1 AND ( (sender_id = #{userId1} AND receiver_id = #{userId2}) OR (sender_id = #{userId2} AND receiver_id = #{userId1}) ) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_message WHERE deleted = 0 AND status != 1 AND ( (sender_id = #{userId1} AND receiver_id = #{userId2}) OR (sender_id = #{userId2} AND receiver_id = #{userId1}) )

SELECT FROM user_message um INNER JOIN ( SELECT CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN receiver_id ELSE sender_id END as contact_id, MAX(created_at) as last_msg_time FROM user_message WHERE deleted = 0 AND status != 1 AND (sender_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId}) GROUP BY CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN receiver_id ELSE sender_id END ) latest ON ( (um.sender_id = #{userId} AND um.receiver_id = latest.contact_id) OR (um.receiver_id = #{userId} AND um.sender_id = latest.contact_id) ) AND um.created_at = latest.last_msg_time AND um.deleted = 0 AND um.status != 1 ORDER BY um.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN receiver_id ELSE sender_id END ) FROM user_message WHERE deleted = 0 AND status != 1 AND (sender_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_message WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND read_status = 0 AND deleted = 0 AND status != 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_message WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND sender_id = #{contactId} AND read_status = 0 AND deleted = 0 AND status != 1
mapper.update: UPDATE user_message SET read_status = 1, read_at = #{readAt}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{readAt}, updated_by = CAST(#{userId} AS VARCHAR) WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND sender_id = #{contactId} AND read_status = 0 AND deleted = 0 AND status != 1
